ITEM 1 | Dark green, finely shredded leafy greens with ruffled edges and visible darker veins, lightly glossy from dressing, forming a loose mound covering roughly 25% of the plate's lower right area, about 12 cm across and 3 cm high; scattered with thin pale shavings and a few small pale crumbs | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale, thin shavings of a light cream-colored firm cheese lying across the greens, matte with slight translucence, about 4 cm long pieces scattered on top of the greens | 8
ITEM 3 | Orange-yellow cubed winter squash pieces with dark green skin edges, roasted with slightly caramelized, matte surfaces and firm, dense flesh; four to five chunks about 2.5 cm across and 1.5 cm high, arranged on the left side of the plate | 90
ITEM 4 | Two pale golden-brown breaded strips with a coarse, crunchy crumb coating and visible toasted seed or nut bits, each about 6 cm long, 2 cm wide and 1.5 cm thick, lying side by side at the upper right edge of the plate | 85
ITEM 5 | Small bright green wilted leaves, glossy and slightly moist, about 5 cm across, folded against the breaded strips at the top of the plate | 12
ITEM 6 | Small scattered golden crumbs from the breading lying loose on the white plate near the breaded strips | 3
